newsitem.title: USA: American sees FY97 with increased earnings.
newsitem.headline: American sees FY97 with increased earnings.

text.p: American Electromedics Corp said Tuesday its results for the fiscal first quarter ending October 26 should be "slightly lower" than expected, but that this shouldn't affect overall revenue and profit estimates for the full 1997 fiscal year.

The company said it expects to continue a trend of increased earnings in fiscal 1997. Earlier in the day the company reported that its fiscal 1996 earnings had doubled to $0.04 per share from the year-ago figure of $0.02 per share.
